# Ansible audit — AZ One Health Sentinel (EpiHack AZ 2026)

**Date:** 2026-05-23 · **Branch:** `feat/profile-dashboards` · **Live demo:** http://epihack-test.cis240692.projects.jetstream-cloud.org/
**Generated by:** background subagent during Phase 0 of `plan/10-archival-and-docs.md`.

This audit is the source-of-truth for Phase 7 (Ansible refresh) of the
archival plan. Each numbered item below is a deliverable: when we
implement it, link the PR back here.

## Top 3 must-fix before archive

1. **`app_client_channel` missing end-to-end.** The 2026-05-20 datastore
   split routes mobile writes to MongoDB and web writes to DuckLake via
   the `X-Client-Channel` header, set from `NEXT_PUBLIC_CLIENT_CHANNEL`.
   The Ansible app role never sets it; the build silently falls back to
   `"web"`. Correct for the VM today, but any Capacitor mobile build off
   the same playbook would silently mis-route — defeating the
   architecture decision. **Fix:** add `app_client_channel: "web"` to
   `group_vars/all.yml` and plumb it through `roles/app/tasks/main.yml`
   and `roles/app/templates/app.env.local.j2`.

2. **Claude.ai custom-connector path is half-wired.** `roles/nginx`
   proxies `/mcp/<name>` per `mcp_http_servers`, but no role creates the
   systemd units that listen on those ports. Only `vectorsurv-mcp`
   honors `FASTMCP_HOST/PORT/STREAMABLE_HTTP_PATH`. And the live demo is
   HTTP-only, but Claude.ai requires HTTPS. **Fix:** add a
   `roles/mcp_servers/tasks/http_units.yml` that renders one systemd
   unit per entry in `mcp_http_servers`; port the FASTMCP shim from
   `vectorsurv-mcp/__main__.py` to the other 10 MCP servers (a repo
   change, not Ansible); flip `tls_enabled: true` with a real
   `vault_tls_email` for the Jetstream2 host.

3. **Synthetic dataset operationally invisible.** The
   4,395-observation demo load under `/srv/onehealth/` came from
   `/tmp/gen_synth.py` — *not* tracked in the repo. `scripts/export_signals.py`
   *is* tracked but is never run by Ansible. Nginx doesn't serve
   `dashboard/signals/`. **Fix:** promote the generator into
   `scripts/load_synthetic_observations.py`, add an opt-in
   `ducklake_load_synthetic_demo` toggle to `roles/ducklake`, and add a
   `/dashboard/` nginx alias gated by a new `serve_dashboard` toggle.

## Per-role findings

### Role 1 — `common` — GREEN

apt base packages, UTC timezone, deploy user + group, `/srv/onehealth/`,
2 GB conditional swap, UFW deny-incoming + allow SSH/80/443, fail2ban.
Note: `mongosh` arrives via `mongodb-org` in `roles/mongodb`, an implicit
cross-role coupling that works fine.

### Role 2 — `node` — YELLOW

Pins `node_major_version: "20"` but next@16 requires Node 20.18.1+.
NodeSource currently ships 20.19+, so a fresh provision works today, but
the pin is implicit. **Add:** a `node --version` assertion task that
exits non-zero below 20.18.1.

### Role 3 — `python` — GREEN

Python 3.12 (`requires-python = ">=3.11"` across all consumers — match),
`uv` to `/usr/local/bin`. Soft pin `uv_version: "latest"` is fine for a
demo.

### Role 4 — `postgres` — GREEN

Postgres 16 as the DuckLake catalog only. No app schema lives directly
in Postgres. Verified that `kg_writer.py` + `audit.py` connect via
`ducklake:postgres:` URIs, not raw `postgresql:`.

### Role 5 — `repo` — GREEN

Two modes: local-path rsync (excluding build artifacts) or git clone
with `force: true`. Both notify `Restart fastapi`. Writes `DEPLOYED_SHA`
marker. Clean.

### Role 6 — `claude_code` — GREEN

`npm i -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code` (`state: latest`), writes
`~/.claude/settings.json` and `.bashrc ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=…` with
`no_log: true`. MCPs are wired in the separate `~/.claude.json` by
design.

### Role 7 — `mcp_servers` — YELLOW

`uv sync` each of the 11 servers, render `~/.claude.json`,
`claude mcp list` smoke. Drift:

- `mcp/wearable-mcp/` is the only server without a `.env.example`.
- The Claude.ai custom-connector path documented in `mcp/vectorsurv-mcp/README.md`
  references a hand-created systemd unit on `:8010` that no role creates.
- Only `vectorsurv-mcp/src/.../__main__.py` reads `FASTMCP_HOST/PORT/STREAMABLE_HTTP_PATH`.
- `SMS_MODE: "mock"` is hard-coded in `claude.json.j2:24`.
- `nws-heatrisk-mcp` has no `NWS_USER_AGENT` env line in the template;
  the server's `.env.example` documents it as required.

**Fix:**

```yaml
# group_vars/all.yml — new vars:
sms_mode:        "mock"
nws_user_agent:  "az-onehealth-sentinel/0.1 (+https://github.com/tyson-swetnam/epihack-2026)"
```

Plus a new `roles/mcp_servers/tasks/http_units.yml` that loops over
`mcp_http_servers` and renders one systemd unit per entry from an
`mcp-http.service.j2` template.

### Role 8 — `ducklake` — GREEN

DuckDB CLI 1.5.3 → `/usr/local/bin`, Parquet dir at
`/srv/onehealth/ducklake-data`, idempotent seed via the kg-mcp venv.
Schema order enforced via `discover_schema_files` (CLAUDE.md's
`standards.sql` then `pathogens.sql` rule).

**Operational gap:** the synthetic demo dataset (4,395 obs) on the
running VM came from a one-off `/tmp/gen_synth.py` that isn't tracked.
Rebuild loses it. See Top-3 fix #3.

### Role 9 — `mongodb` — GREEN

MongoDB 8.0, `bindIp: 127.0.0.1`, `authorization: enabled`, app user
created on `admin` DB via localhost exception, marker file at
`/srv/onehealth/.mongo-user-created` ensures one-time creation. Cross-
references cleanly with `agents/src/onehealth_agents/mongo_writer.py:50`.

### Role 10 — `fastapi` — YELLOW

`uv sync`, pre-install ducklake+postgres DuckDB extensions, env file at
`/etc/onehealth-api.env`, systemd unit with `ProtectHome=true`, wait for
`/v1/healthz` 200, install the Mongo→DuckLake sync timer
(`OnUnitActiveSec=5min`). Drift:

- `DATABASE_URL=postgresql://...` line in `onehealth-api.env.j2:7` is
  unused (`grep -rn DATABASE_URL /home/exouser/epihack-2026/agents/`
  is empty). Delete it.
- `ONEHEALTH_BUILD={{ ansible_date_time.iso8601 }}` changes every run,
  so the env-file template is always "changed", which fires
  `Restart fastapi` on every deploy. Almost certainly intentional, but
  worth flagging.
- No way to disable the Mongo→DuckLake timer on analytics-only hosts.

**Fix:** add `mongo_sync_enabled: true` to `group_vars/all.yml` and
gate the timer's install + start.

### Role 11 — `app` — **RED**

`NEXT_PUBLIC_CLIENT_CHANNEL` is missing from both the build env and
`app.env.local.j2`. This var is the core of the 2026-05-20 datastore
split:

- `app/next.config.mjs:32` defaults it to `"web"`.
- `app/src/lib/api-client.ts:80` sets `X-Client-Channel: CLIENT_CHANNEL`.
- `agents/src/onehealth_agents/api/routes/reports.py:30-43` routes
  `mobile` → MongoDB and anything else → DuckLake.
- `api/openapi.yaml:114` declares the `X-Client-Channel` header.

**Fix:**

```yaml
# group_vars/all.yml — REQUIRED:
app_client_channel: "web"

# roles/app/tasks/main.yml — extend the build env:
environment:
  ...
  NEXT_PUBLIC_CLIENT_CHANNEL: "{{ app_client_channel }}"

# roles/app/templates/app.env.local.j2 — append:
NEXT_PUBLIC_CLIENT_CHANNEL={{ app_client_channel }}
```

### Role 12 — `nginx` — YELLOW

`/api/` → `127.0.0.1:8000`, `/_next/static/` immutable cache,
`/query/` + `/schema/` for DuckDB-WASM, `/mcp/<name>` per
`mcp_http_servers`, `/` → `app/out` static. Security headers good.
Drift:

- No `/dashboard/` location block — the signal-monitor at
  `dashboard/signals/index.html` 404s on the live VM.
- No location blocks for `/figures/`, `/graph/`, `/map/`, `/today/`,
  `/heat/`, `/wildlife/` — those only exist on GH Pages.
- `tls_enabled: false`. Claude.ai connectors require HTTPS.
- `mcp_http_servers: []` empty by default (see Role 7).

**Fix:**

```jinja2
{% if serve_dashboard | default(true) %}
location /dashboard/ {
    alias {{ onehealth_repo_path }}/dashboard/;
    index index.html;
    try_files $uri $uri/ =404;
}
{% endif %}
```

And `tls_enabled: true` with a real `vault_tls_email` for the
Jetstream2 host.

## Cross-cutting

### `playbook.yml` — GREEN

Role order matches `README.md`. `vars_files` correctly limited to
`all.vault.yml` per the prior CHANGELOG fix. Ubuntu/Debian assertion in
`pre_tasks`. Good.

### `requirements.yml` — YELLOW

`community.general`, `community.postgresql`, `ansible.posix`.
`community.mongodb` would enable idempotent user creation (currently
done via `mongosh` + `shell:`).

### `group_vars/all.yml` — YELLOW

Consolidated additions:

```yaml
app_client_channel:            "web"
sms_mode:                      "mock"
mongo_sync_enabled:            true
ducklake_load_synthetic_demo:  false
serve_dashboard:               true
nws_user_agent: "az-onehealth-sentinel/0.1 (+https://github.com/tyson-swetnam/epihack-2026)"
```

### `inventory.yml` is committed with localhost-specific overrides

`inventory.yml:22` sets `onehealth_repo_url: /home/exouser/epihack-2026`
— exouser-specific. A new collaborator running the playbook from a
different machine will rsync the wrong tree. **Fix:** `git rm --cached
ansible/inventory.yml` and keep only `inventory.example.yml`.

### `all.vault.yml` plaintext — acceptable

`vault_postgres_password: "onehealth_local_dev_change_me"` etc. — all
marked as demo placeholders. Real secret slots are empty strings. Fine
for a public archive.

## Draft `ansible/CHANGELOG.md` entry

```markdown
## post-EpiHack archive refresh — 2026-05-23

Tightening pass after the 2026-05-20 datastore split (Mongo for mobile,
DuckLake for web/analytics), the profile-enrichment + personal-dashboard
landing (commit 9039423), and the vectorsurv-mcp Claude.ai connector
deploy (commit 199bcfc). Audit notes in plan/ANSIBLE-AUDIT-2026-05-23.md.

### Changes

- roles/app — added NEXT_PUBLIC_CLIENT_CHANNEL to both the build env
  and app.env.local.j2 so the X-Client-Channel header routing
  (mobile -> Mongo, web -> DuckLake) is honored by every build.
  Driven by a new app_client_channel group var (defaults to "web").
- roles/nginx — added /dashboard/ static-alias block (gated on a new
  serve_dashboard toggle) so the signal-monitor at dashboard/signals/
  resolves on the live VM, not just on GitHub Pages.
- roles/mcp_servers — moved SMS_MODE out of the template into a new
  sms_mode group var; added NWS_USER_AGENT to the nws-heatrisk-mcp env
  block. Added a sibling http_units.yml task file that renders one
  systemd unit per entry in mcp_http_servers, paving the documented
  Claude.ai custom-connector path.
- roles/fastapi — removed unused DATABASE_URL env line from the unit
  env file. Added a mongo_sync_enabled gate around the
  Mongo->DuckLake timer.
- roles/ducklake — added opt-in ducklake_load_synthetic_demo toggle
  that runs scripts/load_synthetic_observations.py (newly tracked,
  promoted from the one-off /tmp/gen_synth.py).
- roles/node — added a node --version >= 20.18.1 assertion.
- group_vars/all.yml — new vars: app_client_channel, sms_mode,
  mongo_sync_enabled, ducklake_load_synthetic_demo, serve_dashboard,
  nws_user_agent.

### Known gaps (not blocking, tracked)

- Only vectorsurv-mcp/src/.../__main__.py honors FASTMCP_HOST/_PORT/
  _STREAMABLE_HTTP_PATH. The other 10 MCP servers need the same shim
  before they can be exposed as Claude.ai remote connectors.
- The live demo (http://epihack-test.cis240692.projects.jetstream-cloud.org)
  still terminates plain HTTP. Claude.ai custom connectors require
  HTTPS — needs tls_enabled: true + a real vault_tls_email.
- mcp/wearable-mcp/ is the only server without a .env.example.
```
